Markets.title: RBL Bank raises $350 million in debut international bond sale
Markets.summary: RBL Bank raised $350 million in its first international bond sale, pricing the debt tighter than initial guidance due to strong investor demand. The funds will support growth at GIFT City and liability management, bolstered by credit backing from Emirates NBD.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets fell for the third consecutive day, with the Sensex dropping 813 points and the Nifty losing 204 points. The decline was driven by soaring oil prices and ongoing Middle East tensions, resulting in a broad-based sell-off that erased over Rs 2 lakh crore from BSE market capitalization.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks slide as oil tops $100, stoking fresh inflation fears
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as Brent crude oil surpassed $100 a barrel due to escalating US-Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions. The surge in fuel prices revived inflation concerns ahead of upcoming economic data and the Federal Reserve's impending interest-rate decision.

Markets.title: Rupee falls to 95.11 vs US dollar as West Asia tensions drive oil fears
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee fell 0.3% to 95.1050 against the US dollar as escalating West Asia tensions pushed Brent crude prices above $100. Central bank intervention limited further losses, though traders expect ongoing volatility due to geopolitical risks and fluctuating oil prices.

Markets.title: Sebi revises rules for open interest violations in commodity derivatives
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has immediately revised position limits and penalties for open interest violations in commodity derivatives. The updated framework caps violation charges, increases penalties for repeat offenses, and updates agricultural commodity classifications to improve risk management and ease compliance.

Markets.title: India lifts ban on JPMorgan unit in index manipulation charge
Markets.summary: India lifted its trading ban on JPMorgan unit Copthall Mauritius and Mansi Share after they deposited Rs 2.96 crore in alleged unlawful gains. The entities were accused of manipulating BSE Sensex closing auction prices, and they can now trade again while the SEBI investigation continues.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel during a stormy parliamentary debate following the far-right party's recent election victory. Merz criticized the AfD's migration policy, arguing that it amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

Geo-Political.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Google is investing €13 billion to build its largest European data centre in Finland. The tech giant states that this infrastructure project will generate tens of thousands of jobs.

Geo-Political.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Brent crude oil reached $100 a barrel for the first time since July following US military strikes on five Iranian tankers. The price increase comes amid escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East involving the US and Houthi forces.

Geo-Political.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
Geo-Political.summary: The United States is banning imports of certain Canadian alcohol, dairy products, and motorbikes in response to recent Canadian counter-tariffs. This action marks the latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the two nations.

Geo-Political.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
Geo-Political.summary: European royalty, including the Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings, attended events in Norway on Wednesday. They gathered to pay their respects to King Harald V.

Geo-Political.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
Geo-Political.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency stated that North Korea has constructed a new two-storey uranium enrichment facility. The nuclear watchdog declared that this development is a cause for serious concern.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS building course. The author achieved this visibility without paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize digital content creation in 2025. These applications help modern creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top ten artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced applications automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity across various sectors.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand agreed to conduct a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also committed to strengthening business-to-business linkages to promote balanced economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Brent crosses $100 as West Asia war raises pressure on India’s economy
Data & Insights.summary: Brent crude surpassed $100 per barrel due to the escalating conflict in West Asia. This price surge threatens to increase India's oil import bill, driving up domestic inflation and fiscal challenges.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet clears  ₹10,783 crore rail expansion as key corridors near capacity
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian cabinet has approved ₹10,783 crore to fund three railway multi-tracking projects spanning 655 kilometers to ease network congestion. These projects will increase freight capacity by 26.69 million tonnes per annum, create jobs, and reduce carbon emissions.

Data & Insights.title: BJP’s war chest grew  ₹905 crore during 2026 polls, Congress’ shrank  ₹66 crore: What EC data reveals
Data & Insights.summary: Election Commission data shows the BJP's war chest grew by ₹905 crore during the 2026 assembly polls while the Congress's shrank by ₹66 crore. Specifically, the Congress reported net receipts of ₹207.17 crore against an expenditure of ₹248.55 crore during the March 15–May 6 election period.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | How has LPG supply eased for second-largest global buyer of domestic cooking gas?
Data & Insights.summary: LPG supply has stabilized for 340 million consumers due to increased domestic production and a shift in imports toward the US and new suppliers. Government booking relaxations and diversification efforts also helped ease the domestic cooking gas crunch.

Data & Insights.title: A bigger Brics, a heavier economy but a harder consensus, explained in charts
Data & Insights.summary: The expanded Brics+ bloc now represents a larger share of the global GDP and strong internal trade. However, the group faces significant challenges, including internal political divisions and India's heavy reliance on imports.

India.title: Stopped From Entering Pub With 'Gutkha' Pouch, Man Sets It Ablaze
India.summary: A Nagpur restaurant owner and chef was stopped from entering a pub because he was carrying a gutkha pouch. Enraged by the denial of entry, he set the pouch ablaze.

India.title: Bihar Board To Felicitate 168 Inter Toppers With Cash Awards And Laptops
India.summary: The Bihar government will honor 168 top students from the 2026 intermediate and matric exams. These students will receive cash prizes and laptop funds from the board.

India.title: Marital Rape: Supreme Court To Re-Examine Law, Its Constitutional Validity
India.summary: The Supreme Court of India is re-examining the constitutional validity of the current marital rape law. Justice Joymalya Bagchi stated during the proceedings that marriage does not mean the extinction of a woman's autonomy.

India.title: Debris In Basement, Wall Removed: What Led To Delhi Building Collapse
India.summary: A Delhi building collapsed after unauthorized construction work, including wall removal and basement excavation, had been underway for over a week. The tragedy resulted from these structural alterations to the property.

India.title: Class 3 Student Dies After Falling From Moving School Van In Madhya Pradesh
India.summary: A Class 3 student died after falling from a moving school van in Madhya Pradesh. The accident happened while the child was returning home within the jurisdiction of the Vijayraghavgarh police station.

India.title: Rajnath Singh Meets Sri Lankan President, Discusses Regional Security
India.summary: Indian Defense Minister Rajnath Singh met with the Sri Lankan president to discuss regional security issues. Singh also congratulated the president on marking two years in office.

General.title: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
General.summary: Police have launched a criminal investigation into donations made to Reform UK. This new inquiry follows a Channel 4 News broadcast and has been combined with an existing investigation into other donations.

General.title: National security can't come at expense of social security, Burnham says
General.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that national security funding must not compromise social security support. He promised to balance defense investments and reduce welfare spending using traditional Labour methods.

General.title: Watch: Europe's royalty pay last respects to King Harald V in Norway
General.summary: Tens of thousands of people lined the streets of Norway after 13 days of national mourning to pay their respects. European royalty also attended the funeral to pay their final respects to King Harald V.

General.title: Miliband rejects chief rabbi's claim British Jews in greater danger after sanctions move
General.summary: Foreign Secretary Miliband has rejected the chief rabbi's claim that imposing sanctions on Israeli settlements increases the danger to British Jews. Miliband stated he disagrees with the assessment that these diplomatic measures put the UK's Jewish community at greater risk.

General.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
General.summary: Uganda's military chief announced that the country is withdrawing from Prince Harry's Invictus Games. This decision was made just two months after Uganda had initially confirmed its participation.

General.title: 'We were raped and exploited by a drug gang as teenagers', women tell BBC of their ordeal
General.summary: Four women who were targeted as children by a drug gang have waived their anonymity to speak out in a BBC documentary. They told the BBC that they were raped and exploited by the criminals as teenagers.
